facts.fact: The terms of reference (PAENS, July 2026) state that the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital (MTN) has validated its Lettre de Politique Sectorielle (LPS), tied to the 2025-2029 National Development Strategy; no adoption is stated and the document gives no date for the validation, so the July 2026 imprint date is used.
